corrections.say: One honest note first: no ad platform can hand us a list of everyone interested in a lawyer. What we can do is combine signals: people near you who are searching for legal help right now, visitors to your website, and careful expansion from there, all inside your area.

questions.prompt: Is your business one of these on Google Maps?
What do you want most from your ads?

options.label: Consultations booked
options.sublabel: Consultations booked online or by phone

options.label: Case enquiries
options.sublabel: Forms and chat on your site

options.label: Awareness
options.sublabel: More people nearby know the firm

questions.prompt: Which service should the ads lead with?
questions.why: Legal matters convert better with a free consultation than a general page, so I plan around booking a consultation.

questions.prompt: Roughly, what is one new {service} client worth to you?
questions.why: I use this to show on the plan what the new customers could be worth to you.

questions.prompt: Where should the ads centre? A street address, or the city and ZIP code. If you would rather say later, just say so.
questions.prompt_stated: You said {stated}. Where in {stated} is the office? A street address or ZIP code keeps the ads close to you.

questions.prompt: How far around {place} should the ads reach?
